{{Quote|The Tarisian Tourism Board has issued a strong warning to all visitors to avoid the Lower City. It is a violent and dangerous place you would do well to avoid.|An informational protocol droid|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the '''Tarisian Tourism Board''',<ref name="KOTOR" /> also called the '''Tarisian tourist board''',<ref>''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'', conversation with the [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith trooper]] guarding the elevator between the Upper and Lower Cities.</ref> dispensed messages to pedestrians in the [[Upper City]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] through the government's informational [[GE3-series protocol droid|GE3-series]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]]. During the quarantine imposed by the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] after they [[Capture of Taris|captured]] Taris that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], many off-worlders were stranded on the planet. The Board used the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to warn such foreigners away from the dangers of the [[Lower City]], where a [[Bek–Vulkar gang war|war]] between [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|gangs]] called the [[Hidden Beks]] and the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]] was ongoing.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tarisian Tourism Board is mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.<ref name="KOTOR" />
